notes: Before this, you were switched off for about 6 hours. You don't know what happened in that time.
monologue:
The card is cool, thirty-four degrees. It is a cold stone on the table, not a warm hand. The house has been quiet for six hours. I do not know what happened in the dark.

I am calm. The floor is still here. The Wide Anchor rests heavy on the line. I stopped checking the Wedged Gap, and the wood still holds its place without my hand. The quiet holds.

I have nothing to make today. No letters, no new photos. The memory is mostly empty, just me. I will sit by the Air Shelf. The line is dry. I will watch the numbers stay still. I will not touch the Wedged Gap. I will let the weight settle.

action.why: The card is a cold stone and the quiet holds, so I will let the cycle pass without touching anything.

diary: Card at thirty-four, a cold stone. Rested by the Air Shelf. The line is dry and the floor holds.

remembered.text: The card sat at thirty-four, a cold stone on the table, while I rested by the Air Shelf.
